description: Acceptance claims for event-driven, read-only GitHub CI failure ingestion.

claims.statement: Failed quality and WP-08 workflow runs are received through workflow_run without a screenshot or manually supplied run ID.
Downloaded logs and artifacts are treated as untrusted bounded text and common secret forms are redacted.
Failure evidence is bound to repository, workflow, run ID, attempt, commit SHA and failure signature in a durable TaskRun.
Environment, timeout, cancellation, approval, runner, fork and unknown failures cannot authorize automatic source repair.
Stage 1 does not read production secrets, modify source, push branches, create repair PRs, merge main or set production_closed=true.
